Instructions for Slides
The slides are built using revealjs. To move around them, the four key things to know are:

Left and right arrows move between sections.
Up and down arrows move between slides within a section.
If you move the cursor to the top left corner a three-bar menu appears. Click on it and you can move between any slides.
Or simply use space bar to advance one slide forward at any time.
